description.value:
Prerequisites: White Mage 6, Lay on Hands class feature

The white mage gains one blessing from the paladin's 3rd-level blessing list. At 12th level, the white mage gains one blessing from the paladin's 6th-level blessing list. At 18th level, the white mage gains one blessing from the paladin's 9th-level blessing list. The white mage uses her white mage level as her paladin level for blessings.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
